control.description-key: Virtual PCF: multi-association review for sprk_communication. Renders the task-015 association provenance as typed connection slots (per-slot confidence + confirm/change, Accept-all, Link-another, create-from-email) and writes the chosen regarding via applyResolverFields (ADR-024). Bind to the sprk_associationprovenance multiline column; place in the OOB form right accessories column.

property.name: associationProvenance
property.description-key: Bound to sprk_associationprovenance (the task-015 Association Engine decision trail JSON). Read-only from the PCF; drives the connection slots.

property.name: associationStatus
property.description-key: Bound to sprk_associationstatus (option-set). Suggested / Pending Review / Ambiguous render the review affordances; Resolved renders as filed. Advanced to Resolved when all review slots are confirmed.

property.name: entity
property.description-key: Dataverse logical name of the host entity (default sprk_communication). Passed to the shared regarding write path (applyResolverFields via ResolverWriteHandler). FR-22 reusability lever.

property.name: readOnly
property.description-key: When true, renders the connections as read-only (no confirm/change/create affordances). Auto-detected from form-disabled state when omitted.

property.name: showVersionFooter
property.description-key: When true (default), displays the PCF version footer at the bottom of the control. Set to false to hide it on production forms.
